summary: Adds a shared exponential backoff helper with a ceiling, an attempt budget and unit tests covering all three behaviours. The change is clean; the only remark is that the delay carries no jitter, so clients that fail together retry together.

findings.summary: Backoff has no jitter, so retries stay synchronised
findings.rationale: The delay is a pure function of the attempt number, so every consumer that failed at the same moment retries at the same moment. After a broker or database outage that means the whole fleet arrives together at 200 milliseconds, then together at 400, which is the load pattern most likely to knock over a dependency that has just come back up.
findings.suggestion: Multiply the delay by a random factor, commonly somewhere between half and full, so the retries spread out over the window instead of landing on it. It is a one-line change and it keeps the ceiling and the attempt budget exactly as they are.
evidence: return { retry: true, delayMs: Math.min(BASE_DELAY_MS * 2 ** attempt, MAX_DELAY_MS) };
